Exactness of order-two coinvariants in characteristic three establishes the quotient homology conclusion. Scope finite and all parameters exact.

value.rationale: The 5×5 board is the first ordinary square chessboard complex with 3-torsion and is a canonical modular equivariant-topology test. The row/column exchange action is a natural missing symmetry invariant on its unique torsion line, selects between genuinely different extensions of the previously known S5×S5 module, and yields an exact mod-three vanishing theorem for the geometric quotient. The fact is narrow but has a motivated object and precise natural invariant; no all-size or stronger downstream theorem is claimed.
